notes: 10H-A observer feasibility audit for the five-state higher-order LPV model. Measurements are yaw rate, lateral acceleration, and applied steering. Exact-model and fleet-Global scheduled Kalman observers are compared with an optimistic algebraic force reconstruction using filtered yaw acceleration and true client geometry/inertia ratio. Observer process-noise scale is selected on development fleets; confirmation uses fresh fleets. Output-feedback LQI uses the frozen H03 controller weights from 10H.
